safe_content_feature_requests.title: Initial Onboarding Tutorial Tooltips
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players instantly understand how to move and fight without confusion.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Currently, a new player is dropped straight into the walk sequence with zero context or instruction.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: First-time players see clear, non-intrusive instructional text prompts during their initial steps on Moss Trail.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Route Discovery & Collection Milestones Ledger
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides clear goals and tracking for completionists who want to 100% every route's unique item pool.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: As an explorer, knowing which collectibles or secrets remain unvisited on routes like Gloomwood Hollow or Moon Shrine drives long-term engagement.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add an in-game menu interface tracking discovered route items, completion counts, and collection milestone rewards.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Combat Mastery Modifiers (Flawless Bonus)
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Provides high-risk, high-reward incentives for players who excel at dodging and fighting without taking damage.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: Rewarding clean combat execution directly aligns with the challenge-and-mastery player persona.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a content modifier that grants bonus coin multipliers or rare crafting materials when completing routes with 100% HP.

safe_content_feature_requests.title: Elite Cosmetic Saving Progress Bar
safe_content_feature_requests.player_value: Gives players clear visibility into how close they are to purchasing high-tier items like the Waypoint Crown.
safe_content_feature_requests.rationale: After buying two mid-tier cosmetics, the player was left with 21 coins and an explicit 'Not enough coins' block, which can feel discouraging without a clear target.
safe_content_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a UI progress tracker in the marketplace showing coin savings toward locked luxury items.

all_feature_requests.title: Obstacle Input Buffering & Command Feedback
all_feature_requests.player_value: Prevents accidental self-damage and makes movement feedback feel more responsive when hitting route obstacles.
all_feature_requests.rationale: Edge-case telemetry shows players frequently spam movement commands when blocked by hazards, leading to frustrating unintended damage states.
all_feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add client-side command validation and input buffering so blocked walk commands prompt an immediate warning state rather than multiple penalty ticks.

observations.evidence: Starting the session on Moss Trail at step 0 immediately transitions to walking actions with no introductory tooltips, tutorial screens, or instruction on controls.
observations.recommendation: Implement onboarding welcome tooltips at step 0 to clearly explain movement and combat mechanics to first-time players.

observations.evidence: The route selection and journey provided little contextual narrative or clarity regarding why Moss Trail was chosen or what to expect next.
observations.recommendation: Add descriptive route preview highlights when selecting a path for the first time.

observations.evidence: Completed Gloomwood Hollow and collected Gloomcap/Root Relic theme items, but lacked an in-game ledger or tracker for collected items.
observations.recommendation: Prioritize the Route Discovery Ledger and Collection Milestones UI (currently listed as a P1 backlog item) so collectors can easily track completion progress.

observations.evidence: Purchased 'trail_cap' successfully for 45 coins, leaving 88 coins; the cosmetics store offers 7 total items to collect.
observations.recommendation: Introduce additional mid-tier cosmetic variations or color tints to give collectors frequent intermediate goals between major hat purchases.

observations.evidence: World state features the Ember Forge route with a temporary coin bonus experiment and Magma Vent Pressure content modifier.
observations.recommendation: Continue utilizing route-specific modifiers and coin bonus experiments to incentivize revisiting older routes like Moss Trail and Ember Forge.

observations.evidence: In a 12-step high-difficulty route (Frostfang Pass, difficulty 3), only 2 enemy encounters occurred (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11), with 9 steps dedicated entirely to basic movement and obstacle jumps.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy spawn frequency and introduce tighter spacing between encounters on difficulty 3+ routes to sustain combat momentum.

observations.evidence: The route reward yielded 25 coins for completing a tier-3 frost route with zero damage taken (100 HP final).
observations.recommendation: Scale completion coin rewards or bonus drops based on player remaining HP or flawless combat execution to reward mastery.

observations.evidence: Completing the Treasure Run provided 25 coins plus 5 found during steps (total 30). Combined with starting capital implied by purchases, two consecutive mid-tier purchases (Trail Cap 45c, Moon Hood 80c) nearly depleted reserves down to 21 coins, locking the player out of premium cosmetics like the Waypoint Crown.
observations.recommendation: Introduce a clear first-time completion bonus or daily bounty reward to bridge the currency gap for elite cosmetic items without breaking core route balance.

observations.evidence: Marketplace feedback correctly handled the insufficient funds state when attempting to purchase 'waypoint_crown' with only 21 coins remaining.
observations.recommendation: Keep the insufficient funds messaging informative, and consider adding a wishlist or saving goal tracker so players see how many more route runs are required for elite items.

observations.evidence: Backlog item lists 'High-Contrast UI Theme & Focus States' due to missing clear keyboard focus rings during marketplace and UI navigation.
observations.recommendation: Implement high-contrast focus rings and visible selection outlines on all interactive UI buttons and marketplace items.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase completed cleanly with clear text feedback ('Purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins.').
observations.recommendation: Keep the concise post-purchase messaging style for marketplace interactions.

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows multiple 'obstacle_hit' events (damage: 8) consecutively when walk commands are sent into an obstacle without a preceding jump.
observations.recommendation: Implement input buffering or command validation to prevent redundant walk commands from queuing or triggering repeated damage against stationary hazards.

observations.evidence: Completing Ember Forge granted +25 coins plus telemetry showing active route coin bonus experiments.
observations.recommendation: Ensure coin scaling modifiers correctly map to reward summaries without risking integer overflow or display desync on high multiplier routes.

reports.session_summary: As a first-time player, I successfully traversed the Moss Trail route from step 0 to step 12. Along the way, I engaged and defeated three enemies (Goblin, Slime, Kobold) and completed the route, earning 25 coins and finishing with 149 total coins and full 100 HP. The session was straightforward, but entirely lacked introductory onboarding prompts or guidance at step 0.

observations.evidence: Starting the session on Moss Trail at step 0 immediately transitions to walking actions with no introductory tooltips, tutorial screens, or instruction on controls.
observations.recommendation: Implement onboarding welcome tooltips at step 0 to clearly explain movement and combat mechanics to first-time players.

observations.evidence: The route selection and journey provided little contextual narrative or clarity regarding why Moss Trail was chosen or what to expect next.
observations.recommendation: Add descriptive route preview highlights when selecting a path for the first time.

bugs.title: Redundant Walk Command Hazard Penalty Loop
repro_steps: Walk into step 2 where an obstacle is present.
bugs.expected: The player should either automatically halt against the obstacle or the system should ignore duplicate walk inputs against a blocking state without repeatedly applying damage ticks.
bugs.observed: Player received multiple consecutive obstacle hits (8 damage each) from repeated walk commands before successfully executing a jump.
